entries.reasonZh: 懸雍垂是軟顎後緣向下垂的小突起，站上只繪出構成它核心的懸雍垂肌，兩者位置相同。
entries.reasonEn: The uvula is the small tip hanging from the rear edge of the soft palate; the site draws only the uvular muscle that forms its core, at the same place.

entries.reasonZh: 杓會厭皺襞是喉入口兩側的黏膜皺褶，內含杓會厭肌；站上只繪出該肌肉，沒有黏膜皺襞本身。
entries.reasonEn: The aryepiglottic fold is the mucosal ridge on each side of the laryngeal inlet and contains the aryepiglottic muscle; the site draws only the muscle, not the fold.

entries.reasonZh: 淚管泛指引流淚液的管道；站上把它分開繪成淚小管與鼻淚管，沒有合稱的單一結構。
entries.reasonEn: Lacrimal ducts is a general term for the channels that drain tears; the site draws them as the lacrimal canaliculi and the nasolacrimal duct, with no single combined structure.

entries.reasonZh: 視網膜神經層屬於視網膜感光的視部；站上以整個視部呈現，沒有再分出神經層與色素上皮層。
entries.reasonEn: The neural layer belongs to the light-sensing optic part of the retina; the site shows the optic part as a whole and does not separate the neural layer from the pigment layer.

entries.reasonZh: 顱骨是包住腦的各塊骨頭合稱；站上把它們分塊繪製，這裡列出構成腦顱的各骨。
entries.reasonEn: The cranium is the collective name for the bones enclosing the brain; the site draws them one by one, so the bones of the braincase are listed here.

entries.reasonZh: 頸動脈管穿過顳骨的岩部，開口在顱底；站上尚未在骨面標示這個孔，最接近的是它所在的顳骨。
entries.reasonEn: The carotid canal runs through the petrous part of the temporal bone and opens on the skull base; the site does not yet mark this opening, so the temporal bone that holds it is shown.

entries.reasonZh: 大腦腳是中腦腹側的粗大纖維束；站上以中腦腳及其底部（腦部詳細模式）呈現。
entries.reasonEn: The cerebral peduncle is the thick fibre bundle on the front of the midbrain; the site shows it as the peduncle of the midbrain and its base, the latter in brain detail mode.

entries.reasonZh: 軟顎是口腔頂後半部的肌肉與黏膜結構；站上沒有整體的軟顎，只繪出構成它的幾條肌肉。
entries.reasonEn: The soft palate is the muscular and mucosal back part of the roof of the mouth; the site has no single soft palate, only the muscles that make it up.

entries.reasonZh: 額枕肌由額腹與枕腹兩部分組成，中間以帽狀腱膜相連；站上把兩部分分開繪成額肌與枕肌。
entries.reasonEn: The occipitofrontalis has a frontal belly and an occipital belly joined by the galea aponeurotica; the site draws the two bellies separately as frontalis and occipitalis.
